sql: SELECT 'trades' AS src, pt.strategy AS a, max(pt.created_at)::text AS b, count(*)::text AS c, '' AS d FROM paper_trades pt WHERE pt.strategy IN ('freeze1','freeze2','freeze3','freeze4') GROUP BY pt.strategy UNION ALL SELECT 'integrity', e.key, ie.kind, coalesce(ie.resolved_at::text,'UNRESOLVED'), left(coalesce(ie.description,''),90) FROM experiment_integrity_events ie JOIN experiments e ON e.id = ie.experiment_id WHERE e.state <> 'RETIRED' UNION ALL SELECT 'gate', e.key, g.gate_key, coalesce(r.verdict,'NO_RESULT'), left(coalesce(r.explanation,''),90) FROM experiment_gates g JOIN experiment_versions v ON v.id = g.version_id JOIN experiments e ON e.id = v.experiment_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT verdict, explanation FROM experiment_gate_results gr WHERE gr.gate_id = g.id ORDER BY gr.computed_at DESC, gr.id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true WHERE e.key IN ('freeze-dark-window-pin','mmsell-correlation-cap') ORDER BY 1,2,3
purpose: is freeze-dark-window-pin's 580h silence already explained by a stand-down or a blocked gate
